resources.string: Every player has a grid of holes and everyone plays at once: tap a hole to whack what pops out of it. Moxie the mole scores 10, Goldie the gopher (a star on her cap) scores 30, and spiky Prickle costs 20 points and breaks your streak. Five hits in a row count double, ten count triple. Every grid gets the same critters at the same moments.
Get ready! Tap the round-faced critters and spare the spiky ones.
The grid was reduced to 3 x 3 so every hole is big enough to tap.
One-switch play: press anywhere in the zone to whack the hole the cursor is on.
Prickle the urchin, do not tap
%1$s: %2$d points · best streak %3$d · %4$d bonus · %5$d decoys hit
